## GPT-5.4 Mini API

GPT-5.4 Mini is a large language model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `openai-gpt-54-mini`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

GPT-5.4 Mini brings the core capabilities of GPT-5.4 to a faster, more efficient model optimized for high-throughput workloads. It supports text and image inputs with strong performance across reasoning, coding, and tool use.

### GPT-5.4 Mini API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openai-gpt-54-mini` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.75 / $4.50 per 1M |

### How to use the GPT-5.4 Mini API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses` with `"model": "openai-gpt-54-mini"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai-gpt-54-mini",
    "input": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences.",
    "reasoning": { "effort": "high" }
  }'
```
